definitions.name: resolution_validity
definitions.statement: A governed resolution may be structurally and evidentially valid independently of whether the requested effect is authorized or realized.

definitions.name: requested_effect_authorization
definitions.statement: Requested-effect authorization is distinct from resolution validity.

definitions.name: requested_effect_realization
definitions.statement: Requested-effect realization is distinct from resolution validity and requested-effect authorization.

definitions.name: organization_state
definitions.statement: Organization state Omega contains component states, declared cross-component relation states, and evidence/provenance for those relations.

definitions.name: minimum_admissible_transition_set
definitions.statement: Every conforming admissibility surface supports DENY, REVIEW, and FAIL_CLOSED as distinct governed realized transition classes; the supported class set may contain additional profile-defined classes.

axioms.name: resolution_realization
axioms.statement: Every governed admissibility resolution incorporated into system history realizes a successor state.

axioms.name: resolution_successor_separation
axioms.statement: Resolution classification is not the successor state.

axioms.name: requested_effect_separation
axioms.statement: Non-realization of the sought effect does not imply absence of a realized transition or successor information.

axioms.name: confirmation_non_nullity
axioms.statement: Delta(object_value)=0 does not imply Delta(system_state)=0 when a new confirmation or evidentiary relation is established.

axioms.name: relational_closure
axioms.statement: A complete successor representation includes known material relation changes and confirmations within the applicable concern boundary.

axioms.name: concern_set_propagation
axioms.statement: The concerned manifold/component set expands through material relations rather than automatically to the entire organization.

axioms.name: transition_caused_observation
axioms.statement: Observation of a realized transition is consequent to state transition; a periodic heartbeat may carry or reference observations but is not the primitive cause.

axioms.name: composition_sensitivity
axioms.statement: Individually valid local transitions are not guaranteed to remain valid under composition, ordering, concurrency, or coupling.

axioms.name: authority_non_generation
axioms.statement: Observation, validation, confirmation, relation coherence, workflow success, and this formalism do not generate source, execution, credential, release, publication, or proof authority.
